newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - Aug 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - Aug 4.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Yizheng Chemical Fibre Co Ltd says it has received no formal notification from senior administrators about a merger with any other chemical company, and is not in negotiations with any other firms.
- BUSINESS NEWS - China's video compact disc (VCD) output surged to four million in the first half of 1997 from 20,000 in 1994, accounting for 85 percent of the market over imported products.
